agenda_text:
AGENDA
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Wednesday, March 16, 2022
  10:00 AM

  Approval of minutes from February 16, 2022 meeting.

  1.  Senior Nutrition Programs  Grab-&-Go meals: meals were distributed to an avg. of 103
  participants per week in February

  Meals on wheels: 766 meals served to 50 La Verne recipients
  in February

  2.  Guest Speaker  Shawn Igoe–Public Works Director

  3.  Bingo Report  Bingo Representative will present financials.

  4.  Account Balance Update  $4,731.00

  5.  Monthly Senior Program Fees  Monthly Update

  6.  Mt. SAC Classes  Monthly Update

  7.  Aging Next  Monthly Update

  8.  Facilities Report  Monthly Update

  9.  Older Americans Recognition  Outstanding Older American Recognition nomination

  10.  Upcoming Events
  -  Monday, April 11th– Movie Matinee, 12:30PM
  -  Tuesday, April 26th – Senior Scrapbooking, 4:00PM-
  8:00PM
  -  Sunday, May 15th – Havana Nights Dinner Dance
  Extravaganza, 4:00PM-7:00PM
  11.  11.  Public Comments  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the
  Senior Advisory Committee on items not listed on the agenda

  12.  12.  Adjournment of Meeting  The next meeting will be Wednesday, April 20, 2022 at
  10:00AM

Posting Statement: On March 10, 2022, a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on the
bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, CA and on the City’s website at
cityoflaverne.org.
